name: Dockge
description: Dockge is a web interface for managing Docker Compose stacks. Self-host it on your own server with Panara Cloud, which deploys Dockge as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Web UI for managing Docker Compose stacks. Deploy Dockge with Docker Compose on Panara Cloud in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
